A '''female''' individual was a companion of [[Pizztov]] and was referred to by him as "'''Annoying Female'''". She tried to coax Pizztov into giving her the box, although he struck her for talking out of line. After [[Sintas Vel]] and [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] arrived to retrieve the box, Pizztov threatened her life by using her as a human shield in order to ensure his escape, although Sintas and Boba didn't care either way. She was last seen expressing relief that she hadn't died from the firefight after Pizztov decided to "play rude" by throwing her at Sintas while firing at Boba Fett.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:AnnoyingPointyEaredFemale-SWT7.jpg|thumb|left|[[Pizztov]] strikes his pointy-eared companion.]]

Chee]], maintainer of the [[Holocron continuity database]], stated that his theory is that "all pointy-eared species are either [[Sephi/Legends|Sephi]] or closely related to Sephi."<ref name="TT">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=1395#16675997|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2007-06-08|time=6:48 AM}}</ref>
